## 📦 Product submission

- [ ] Folder `projects/<slug>/` containing only a valid `project.yaml` (slug matches folder name)
- [ ] The product is a working build; its public repo contains everything (code, screenshots, docs, demo)
- [ ] Uses ≥1 AIsa endpoint beyond plain model calls, declared in `aisa_endpoints_used` and genuinely called by the product
- [ ] Entering the competition? `competition: "<cycle>"` is set in the metadata
